item.title: [Episode 18] "The System Has Identified the Enemy" ([18화] “시스템이 적을 식별했습니다”)
item.description:
[Episode 18] "The System Has Identified the Enemy" ([18화] “시스템이 적을 식별했습니다”)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Around 4 PM, the weather in the highlands changed without warning. Cold air currents, laden with moisture from the Sea of Okhotsk, climbed the slopes of the Taebaek Mountain Range and began to condense rapidly. (오후 4시 무렵, 고성의 기상이 예고 없이 뒤바뀌었다. 오호츠크해에서 습기를 머금고 밀려온 차가운 기류가 태백산맥의 사면을 타고 오르며 급격히 응결하기 시작했다.)

In just ten minutes, all the colors of the DMZ evaporated. The ridgelines that Sariel had vividly drawn in emerald green moments before vanished, and a white curtain, obscuring even a single inch ahead, swallowed the barbed wire fence. (불과 10분 만에 DMZ의 모든 색채가 증발했다. 방금 전까지 사리엘이 비취색으로 선명하게 그려냈던 능선들은 사라지고, 한 치 앞도 분간할 수 없는 백색의 장막이 철책을 집어삼켰다.)

It was a sea fog capable of blinding not only human eyes but also the clumsy eyes of machines. (인간의 눈은 물론, 어설픈 기계의 눈마저 멀게 만드는 해무(海霧)였다.)

Evan sat with a cold canned coffee in the nearby monitoring station, visualizing the invisible battlefield beyond the fog outside the window. Due to security regulations and the need to maintain fairness, on-site access was restricted during the competitor's demonstration time. (에반은 인근 대기소에서 차가운 캔커피를 쥔 채, 창밖의 안개 너머 보이지 않는 전장을 머릿속에 그렸다. 보안 규정과 공정성 유지를 위해 경쟁사 데모 시간에는 현장 입장이 제한되었다.)

"Alright, it's Sentinel's turn now." (“자, 이제 센티넬 차례입니다.”)

Inside the server room, the Woosung Industries-Sentinel consortium team stood before the console. The Sentinel technical team deployed the latest high-performance LiDAR sensors at the front of the demonstration area. LiDAR, which measures distance by the reflection time of emitted lasers, is equipment boasting precision down to 1 centimeter on a clear day. (서버실 안, 우성인더스트리-센티넬 컨소시엄 팀이 콘솔 앞에 섰다. 센티넬 기술팀은 최신형 고성능 라이다(LiDAR) 센서를 시연장 전면에 배치했다. 레이저를 쏘아 반사 시간으로 거리를 측정하는 라이다는, 맑은 날이라면 1cm 단위의 정밀도를 자랑하는 장비다.)

But in this extreme sea fog, everyone was on edge. (하지만 지금 같은 극한의 해무 앞에서, 모두가 긴장을 놓치 못했다.)

"Why is the data reception sensitivity like this?" (“데이터 수신 감도가 왜 이래?”)

Sentinel's lead engineer couldn't hide his bewildered expression as he typed on the keyboard. (센티넬 수석 엔지니어가 키보드를 두드리며 당황스러운 표정을 감추지 못했다.)

Laser pulses, striking moisture particles in the air, scattered in all directions before even reaching the target. The monitor was flooded with hundreds of thousands of meaningless data fragments. Sentinel's algorithm struggled, failing to distinguish this noise from actual objects. (공기 중 수분 입자에 부딪힌 레이저 펄스가 목표물에 닿기도 전에 사방으로 퍼져버렸다. 모니터에는 수십만 개의 무의미한 데이터 파편이 쏟아졌다. 센티넬의 알고리즘은 이 노이즈를 실제 물체와 구분하지 못하고 허우적댔다.)

"Lower the threshold! Reapply the noise filtering!" (“임계값 낮춰! 노이즈 필터링 다시 걸어!”)

The voice of the technical team leader dispatched from the U.S. headquarters grew urgent. The engineers' fingers moved busily over the keyboards, but the data on the screen spiraled out of control. (미국 본사에서 파견된 기술팀장의 목소리가 다급해졌다. 엔지니어들의 손가락이 키보드 위를 바쁘게 움직였지만, 화면 속 데이터는 통제 불능으로 치달았다.)

At that moment, Sentinel's perimeter interface flashed red with a warning sound. (그 순간, 센티넬의 경계 인터페이스가 경고음과 함께 붉게 점멸했다.)

BEEP—. BEEP—. (삐이이익—. 삐이이익—.)

[WARNING: UNIDENTIFIED OBJECT DETECTED] ([WARNING: UNIDENTIFIED OBJECT DETECTED])

[Identification Probability: North Korean Infantry 70.2%] ([식별 확률: 북한군 보병 (Infantry) 70.2%])

[Location: 50m forward, near GP Outpost 2] ([위치: 전방 50m, GP 2초소 인근])

It was a signal that a faint heat source had been detected in the middle of the thick fog. A 70% identification rate. A figure that, under engagement rules, would warrant immediate warning fire. (흐릿한 열원 하나가 짙은 안개 한복판에 포착되었다는 신호였다. 식별률 70퍼센트. 교전 수칙상 즉각적인 경고 사격을 고려해야 할 수치였다.)

A look of relief and tension crossed the face of the Woosung Industries executive simultaneously. He turned to look at Manager Park Gwan-gyu and reported. (우성인더스트리 임원의 얼굴에 안도와 긴장이 동시에 스쳤다. 그가 박관규 실장을 돌아보며 보고했다.)

"Chief, there are signs of an incursion. The system has identified the enemy." (“실장님, 침투 징후입니다. 시스템이 적을 식별했습니다.”)

But the expressions of the Sentinel engineers were different. Sweating nervously, they exchanged whispers. (하지만 센티넬 엔지니어들의 표정은 달랐다. 식은땀을 흘리며 서로 귓속말을 주고받았다.)

"Wait, is that thermal signature valid?" (“Wait, is that thermal signature valid?”)

"It's drifting... It might be the fog layer." (“It’s drifting... It might be the fog layer.”)

Chief Park continued taking notes with a calm demeanor. He minimized his movements and spoke even less. Unlike the excited Woosung executive, he checked the coordinates on the monitor with an emotionless gaze. (박 실장은 차분한 자세로 메모를 이어갔다. 동작은 최소한으로 줄이고, 말은 더 아꼈다. 흥분한 우성 임원과 달리, 감정을 뺀 눈빛으로 모니터 상의 좌표를 확인했다.)

"Let's verify it." (“검증해 보죠.”)

Chief Park picked up the radio. (박 실장이 무전기를 들었다.)

"The control center to the forward GP. The system has identified an unidentified object at a point 50 meters in front of your post, coordinates 3-Alpha sector. Please cross-check visually and with TOD." (“통제본부에서 전방 GP에 알린다. 현재 시스템상 귀소 전방 50미터 지점, 좌표 3-알파 구역에 미상 물체 식별됨. 육안 및 TOD 교차 확인 바란다.”)

Every breath in the server room seemed to stop. The static noise of the radio crackled for several seconds. (서버실의 모든 숨소리가 멈췄다. 치직거리는 무전기 노이즈가 수 초간 흘렀다.)

"...This is GP Outpost 2. Results of visual and night-vision scope check: no unusual activity. Forward visibility is zero, but no bio-signals detected on thermal equipment. Over." (“……여기는 GP 2초소. 육안 및 야간 투시경 확인 결과, 특이사항 없습니다. 전방 시야 제로 상태이나, 열상 장비상 생체 신호 잡히지 않습니다. 이상.")

A false detection. (오탐.)

The expressions of both Woosung and Sentinel executives hardened. Sentinel engineers muttered about a system error and frantically searched through the logs. (우성과 센티넬 임원 모두 표정이 굳었다. 센티넬 엔지니어들은 시스템 오류라 중얼거리며 황급히 로그를 뒤졌다.)

Sentinel's technical advisor loosened his tie and began to explain. (센티넬 측 기술고문이 넥타이를 느슨하게 풀며 해명에 나섰다.)

"Chief, this isn't equipment error. Even AI has to deal with uncertainty in such extreme weather. We applied a conservative safety design—in technical terms, a fail-safe logic—to alert for potential risks in advance. It's safer to raise a warning than to miss something." (“실장님, 이건 장비 오류가 아닙니다. AI도 이런 극한의 기상에서는 불확실성을 가질 수밖에 없습니다. 저희는 만약의 위험 가능성을 미리 알려주는 보수적 안전 설계, 전문 용어로 페일 세이프(Fail-safe) 로직을 적용한 겁니다. 놓치는 것보다 경고를 띄우는 게 안전하니까요.”)

Chief Park slowly set down the ballpoint pen he was holding onto the evaluation sheet. He raised his eyes and looked at the technical advisor. (박 실장은 들고 있던 볼펜을 평가표 위에 천천히 내려놓았다. 고개를 들어 기술고문을 응시했다.)

"The military does not call that 'safety.'" (“군에서는 그걸 ‘안전’이라 부르지 않습니다.”)

His voice was still flat. (목소리에는 여전히 높낮이가 없었다.)

"If this kind of conservative design goes off every night, soldiers will dismiss even real infiltration signals as machine errors and ignore them." (“매일 밤 이런 식의 보수적 설계가 울려대면, 병사들은 진짜 침투 신호조차 기계 오류로 치부하고 무시하게 되겠죠.”)

Chief Park picked up the pen again. (박 실장이 볼펜을 다시 집어 들었다.)

"That's what we call noise that induces operational failure." (“작전 실패를 유도하는 노이즈라는 겁니다.”)

The Sentinel team was speechless. More than yelling or shouting, nothing is more intimidating than a red line drawn by citing a regulation book. (센티넬 팀은 아무 말도 하지 못했다. 화를 내거나 소리를 지르는 것보다, 규정집을 들이대며 긋는 빨간 줄이 훨씬 무서운 법이다.)

It was the moment when the gap between what Sariel had proven and the error Sentinel had spewed out made the scoring for price meaningless. (사리엘이 증명한 사실과 센티넬이 내뱉은 오류 사이의 간극이, 가격이라는 배점을 이미 무의미하게 만들어 버린 순간이었다.)

Manager Kim Jin-myeong from the Planning and Budget Office, standing in the corner, looked down at the documents with a stiff expression. He was confronted with how powerless his logic, talked about cost-effectiveness back in the cubicle, was in the face of field data. (구석에 서 있던 기획예산처 김진명 과장이 굳은 표정으로 서류를 내려다보았다. 큐비클 안에서 가성비를 운운했던 자신의 논리가 현장의 데이터 앞에서 얼마나 무력한지를 직면했다.)

The two silently wrote down numbers on the evaluation sheet. (두 사람은 묵묵히 평가표에 숫자를 써 내려갔다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil on US Visit: “Over 70 Years of Korea-US Alliance, Like Properly Aged Kimchi” (訪美 송영길 “70년 넘은 한미동맹, 제대로 숙성된 김치 같은 것”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil on US Visit: “Over 70 Years of Korea-US Alliance, Like Properly Aged Kimchi” (訪美 송영길 “70년 넘은 한미동맹, 제대로 숙성된 김치 같은 것”)

Song Young-gil, former leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who is visiting the United States as a special envoy of National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, said on the 24th, “Kimchi takes a long time to ferment, and the more properly it ages, the deeper its flavor becomes,” adding, “The Korea-US alliance, which has endured for over 70 years, is the same. We have all matured and formed a deep bond that goes beyond simple cooperation.” During a speech at the ‘Korean Culture Day’ event hosted by the Korean American Immigration History Museum (Director Kim Min-sun) at the Library of Congress that afternoon, the former leader stated, “There may be slight differences in perspective, but the consensus on the Korea-US alliance, a powerful entity we must protect, cannot be questioned.” <<> With Representative Jeong Cheong-rae stepping down from his leadership position on the 24th and formally announcing his bid for party leadership, it is known that former leader Song will also officially announce his candidacy shortly after returning to Korea. On this day, Representative Song met with House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries, as well as Korean-American Democratic Senator Andy Kim and Republican Representative Young Kim. He noted that while President Yoon Suk Yeol and President Donald Trump maintain a very good relationship, there is significant political strife in Korea, and “there may be differing evaluations of the alliance and different perspectives on current issues,” yet he added, “Regardless of which party we belong to, the Korea-US alliance is a pillar protecting the lives of our people, and there is a unanimous consensus that we pursue the same values.” <<> Representative Song also attended a press conference on a Korea-US alliance resolution hosted by pro-Korean Congressman Tom Suozzi in the Capitol that afternoon, alongside People Power Party Representative Cho Kyung-tae. He expressed pride that “Korea and the US have grown together pursuing the same values, such as the rule of law, free market system, fundamental rights, and the judicial system.” He also expressed gratitude regarding the December 3 martial law incident under former President Yoon Suk Yeol, saying, “All members of the National Assembly cooperated almost with one mind against the ‘dictatorial regime’ that neutralized the constitution,” and noted, “The lawmaker who led the charge from the opposition at that time was my colleague, Representative Cho Kyung-tae.” On the 25th, Representative Song is scheduled to attend an event related to the so-called ‘Korean Peninsula Peace Act’ hosted by the Korean American Participation Forum (KAPAC). <<> In April, just before the June National Assembly by-election, Representative Song visited Washington DC and met with Tulsi Gabbard, Director of National Intelligence and former head of intelligence under the Trump administration, among others. Gabbard, a former Democratic congresswoman who supported Trump in the 2024 presidential election, published a book titled ‘For Love of Country’ that sharply criticizes ‘woke’ culture. Representative Song, who was impressed by the book, personally translated it and published it while he was detained at Seoul Detention Center. At the time, he had left the Democratic Party and was affiliated with the ‘Pine Tree Party,’ and contrary to the original title, the Korean edition was titled ‘Leaving the Democratic Party.’ (조정식 국회의장 특사 자격으로 미국을 방문 중인 송영길 전 더불어민주당 대표는 24일 “김치는 숙성에 오랜 시간이 걸리고 제대로 숙성될수록 깊은 풍미를 띠게 된다”며 “70년 넘는 기간 지속된 한미동맹도 이와 같다. 우리 모두는 성숙해졌고, 단순한 협력 이상의 깊은 유대감을 형성하고 있다”고 했다. 송 전 대표는 이날 오후 미주한인이민사박물관(관장 김민선)이 의회 도서관에서 주최한 ‘한국 문화의 날’ 행사 연설에서 “관점에 약간의 차이가 있을 수 있지만 우리가 지켜야 할 강력한 존재인 한미동맹에 대한 합의가 의심받을 수는 없다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

item.title: "Republicans and Democrats Clash, but US-ROK Relations Will Not Be Used as a Political Tool" (“공화·민주 다투지만 한미 관계는 정치적 도구로 삼지 않을 것”)
item.description:
"Republicans and Democrats Clash, but US-ROK Relations Will Not Be Used as a Political Tool" (“공화·민주 다투지만 한미 관계는 정치적 도구로 삼지 않을 것”)

Tom Suozzi, a Democratic congressman and one of the most prominent pro-South Korea figures in the U.S. Congress, held a press conference in front of the Capitol in Washington, D.C. on the 24th, stating, "There is plenty in the world to be discouraged about—war, economic issues, division—but if you want hope for the future, look at the journey the United States and South Korea have taken together over the past 76 years." He emphasized that while political strife between the Republican and Democratic parties is real, the two sides are always "one" when it comes to bilateral issues concerning U.S.-ROK relations. Suozzi, along with Korean-American Republican Congressman Young Kim and Democratic Congresswoman Grace Meng, who has a Korean-American spouse, introduced a resolution (H.Res. 64) in January of last year reaffirming the importance of the U.S.-ROK alliance. (미 의회의 대표적인 지한파(知韓派) 인사인 톰 수오지 민주당 하원의원은 24일 워싱턴 DC의 의회 의사당 앞에서 기자회견을 열어 “전쟁, 경제 문제, 분열 등 세상에 낙담할 일이 많지만 미래에 대한 희망을 갖고 싶다면 지난 76년 동안 미국과 한국이 함께 걸어온 여정을 살펴보라”며 공화당과 민주당 간 정쟁이 있는 것은 사실이지만 한미 관계에 관한 양자(兩者) 현안에 있어서는 언제나 ‘하나’라는 점을 강조했다. 수오지는 한국계 영 김 공화당 하원의원, 한국계를 배우자로 둔 그레이스 맹 민주당 의원과 지난해 1월 한미동맹에 대한 중요성을 재확인하는 결의안(H.Res. 64)을 발의했다.)

Suozzi, a four-term congressman representing New York, said, "Think about the transformation and incredible success of a country devastated by war in 1950. A nation that was in despair has now become one of the world's leading powers in the economy, democracy, human rights, and the rule of law—it's truly remarkable." He added, "Currently, the world is witnessing a struggle between countries that share the same values as the U.S. and South Korea—believing in free markets, opposing government intervention and corporate subsidies, and upholding the rule of law—and authoritarian states that do not. To get more people to embrace the values we share, we need to build more friendships." (뉴욕주(州)를 지역구로 하는 4선(選) 의원인 수오지는 “1950년 전쟁으로 황폐해진 나라에서 일어난 변화와 놀라운 성공을 생각해 보라”며 “절망에 빠졌던 나라가 이제는 경제, 민주주의, 인권, 법치 분야에서 세계를 이끄는 리더 중 하나로 거듭난 모습이 정말 놀랍다”고 했다. 이어 “현재 세계에선 한미같이 같은 가치를 가진 나라들과 자유 시장을 믿지 않고, 정부의 개입과 기업에 대한 보조금을 지지하며, 법치주의를 중요하게 생각하지 않는 권위주의 국가들과의 다툼이 진행되고 있다”며 더 많은 사람이 한미가 공유하는 가치를 받아들일 수 있게 만들기 위해 “우정을 더 많이 쌓아야 한다”고 했다.)

The resolution, which highlights the importance of the U.S.-ROK alliance, the sacrifices of Korean War veterans, and the continued strengthening of strategic cooperation between the two nations, passed the House Foreign Affairs Committee with a vote of 43 to 3 on May 13 and is now awaiting a full floor vote. When asked about the prospects and timing of the resolution's passage, Suozzi told our newspaper, "This resolution only needs to be scheduled for a full House vote. It has bipartisan support and will definitely pass. There's so much going on in Congress these days; it's just a matter of when it can be addressed." House Foreign Affairs Committee Ranking Democrat Gregory Meeks said, "Democrats and Republicans may have differences in political views, but we do not use South Korea as a political tool. Our relationship with a friend (South Korea) cannot be a political issue." (한미동맹의 중요성, 6·25 전쟁 참전용사들의 희생, 한미 전략적 협력의 지속적 강화 등을 담고 있는 결의안은 지난 5월 13일 하원 외교위원회에서 43대3으로 통과돼 본회의 표결을 앞둔 상태다. 수오지는 결의안 통과 전망과 시점을 묻는 본지 질의에 “이 결의안은 본회의 상정만 남았다”며 “양당의 지지를 받고 있어 확실히 통과할 것이다. 요즘 의회에서 다른 일들이 너무 많이 진행되고 있는데, 단지 언제 처리할 수 있을지 일정의 문제”라고 했다. 하원 외교위 민주당 간사인 그레고리 믹스 의원은 “민주당과 공화당이 정치적 견해 차이가 있을 수 있지만 우리는 한국을 정치적 도구로 삼지 않는다”며 “친구(한국)와의 관계는 정치적 쟁점이 될 수 없다”고 했다.)

Before the press conference, at the "Korean Culture Day" event organized by the Korean American Immigration History Museum (directed by Kim Min-sun) at the Library of Congress, Congresswoman Young Kim, who introduced the resolution, took the stage alongside Suozzi. Kim, who chairs the Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on Asia and the Pacific, said, "When you watch the news, it's all about promoting division, but regardless of party affiliation, lawmakers are always striving to find common ground. This resolution is an example of that." Kim, who is running for a fourth term in the November midterm elections, added, "I came as an immigrant and became a proud American. America embraces diversity, allowing us to maintain our own cultures and traditions. Please don’t forget that I am the only Korean-American in the Republican Party." (이날 기자회견에 앞서 의회 도서관에서 미주한인이민사박물관(관장 김민선)이 주최한 ‘한국 문화의 날’ 행사에선 결의안을 발의안 영 김 의원이 수오지와 함께 무대에 올랐다. 외교위 동아시아·태평양 소위원장인 김 의원은 “뉴스를 보면 온통 분열을 조장하는 내용으로 가득하지만, 의원들은 서로 정당이 달라도 항상 공통점을 찾기 위해 노력하고 있다”며 “결의안이 그 모범 사례”라고 했다. 11월 중간 선거에서 4선에 도전하는 김 의원은 “이민자로 와서 자랑스러운 미국인이 될 수 있었는데 다양성을 포용하는 미국은 우리 각자의 문화, 전통을 유지할 수 있게 해준다. 내가 공화당의 유일한 한국계라는 사실을 잊지 말아 달라”라고 했다.)

Currently, a bill known as the "Partnership with Korea Act (PWKA)"—which would issue separate visas for skilled Korean professionals—has been introduced in Congress under Congresswoman Young Kim's name. Following last year's incident at the Hyundai Motor and LG Energy Solution plant in Georgia, there has been a legislative campaign inside and outside Congress, and the South Korean Embassy in the U.S. has hired lobbyists, with Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha actively lobbying lawmakers. Suozzi said, "South Korean companies are among the largest foreign investors in the U.S. It's very important to temporarily bring in personnel from South Korea to train our workers and help more people become familiar with the technology in the process. What happened in Georgia must never happen again." Suozzi also emphasized that "both countries should remove barriers and create an open environment for more effective trade." (현재 의회에는 숙련된 한국인 전문직에 한해 별도의 비자를 발급하는 이른바 ‘한국과의 파트너 법안(PWKA)’이 영 김 의원 명의로 발의돼 있다. 지난해 조지아주(州) 현대차·LG에너지솔루션 공장 구금 사태를 계기로 의회 안팎에서 입법 캠페인이 벌어지고 있고, 주미 대사관도 로비스트를 고용해 강경화 대사가 의원들을 상대로 로비 활동을 하고 있다. 수오지는 “한국 기업들은 미국의 최대 외국인 투자자”라며 “일시적이라도 (한국에서) 인력을 데려와 우리 근로자들을 교육하고, 더 많은 사람들이 그 과정에서 (기술에) 익숙해질 수 있도록 하는 것이 매우 중요하다. 조지아에서 발생한 일이 다시는 반복되면 안 된다”고 했다. 수오지는 “양국이 더 효과적인 무역을 위해 장벽을 없애고 개방적인 환경을 조성해야 한다”고도 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] “Even After Wartime Operational Control Transition… US Must Establish Northeast Asia Command to Deter North Korea” ([단독] “전작권 전환돼도… 美가 동북아사령부 만들어 지휘해야 北 대응 가능”)
item.description:
[Exclusive] “Even After Wartime Operational Control Transition… US Must Establish Northeast Asia Command to Deter North Korea” ([단독] “전작권 전환돼도… 美가 동북아사령부 만들어 지휘해야 北 대응 가능”)

In a report released on the 18th (local time), the US think tank Atlantic Council argued that “given North Korea’s advanced nuclear and missile capabilities and China’s attempts to pressure and attack the entire first island chain, the separation (of US Forces Korea and US Forces Japan) is no longer sustainable,” calling for the establishment of a new “US Northeast Asia Command” to integrate and manage US forces in South Korea and Japan. The first island chain refers to a maritime defensive line connecting the Japanese archipelago to Taiwan and the Philippines. (미국 싱크탱크 애틀랜틱카운슬이 지난 18일(현지 시각) 공개한 보고서에서 “북한의 고도화된 핵·미사일 능력과 제1도련선 전체를 압박하고 공격하려는 중국의 시도를 고려할 때 (주한미군과 주일미군의) 분리는 더 이상 지속 가능하지 않다”며 ‘미 동북아사령부’를 신설해 주한·주일미군을 통합 관리해야 한다고 주장했다. 제1도련선은 일본 열도에서 대만과 필리핀을 연결하는 해양 방어선이다.)

The authors further stated that even after wartime operational control (OPCON) is transferred to South Korean forces, and despite South Korean commanders of the future combined command coordinating defense operations, the stationing of US Forces Korea and support from US Forces Japan should be conducted “under the broader authority of the Northeast Asia Command.” This report included Colonel Christopher Lee, a Foreign Area Officer (FAO) for the Indo-Pacific region assigned to US Forces Korea, as a co-author. (저자들은 또 한국군으로 전시작전통제권(전작권)이 이양된 후, 한국 방어 작전은 미래연합사의 한국군 사령관이 조율하더라도, 이를 뒷받침하는 주한미군 주둔과 주일미군의 지원은 “동북아사령부의 더 넓은 권한(authority) 하”에서 이뤄져야 한다고 했다. 이번 보고서에는 주한미군 소속의 인도·태평양 담당 해외지역장교(FOA)인 크리스토퍼 리 대령이 공동 저자로 참여했다.)

In the report, they discussed the possibility that provocations by North Korea or a Chinese attack on Taiwan could lead to a “simultaneous crisis” on both fronts, stating that “the security of Japan and South Korea is inseparably linked, and the security of both countries is directly connected to the stability of the entire first island chain, including Taiwan.” Therefore, they argued that the current system, where the US Pacific Command communicates separately with US Forces Japan and US Forces Korea through independent channels, is inefficient. They suggested that “establishing a Northeast Asia Command under the Pacific Command, with responsibility over Japan, South Korea, and surrounding areas, could reduce structural inefficiencies,” as the Pacific Command currently oversees more than 30 countries and regions. (이들은 보고서에서 북한의 도발이나 중국의 대만 공격 등이 양 전선의 ‘동시 위기’로 이어질 가능성을 거론하며 “일본과 한국의 안보는 불가분하게 연결돼 있으며, 양국 안보는 대만을 포함한 제1도련선 전체의 안정과도 직결돼 있다”고 했다. 따라서 미국 태평양사령부가 주일미군, 주한미군과 각기 별도의 채널로만 소통하는 현재의 체제가 효율적이지 않다는 것이다. 이들은 30여 국 이상의 지역을 관할하는 태평양사령부 산하에 “일본, 한국 및 주변 지역을 책임 구역으로 하는 동북아사령부를 창설하면 구조적 비효율성을 줄일 수 있다”고 했다.)

They claimed that a Northeast Asia Command would ensure that even after the OPCON transition, “the US military command chain can exercise authority over US forces in South Korea and Japan, guaranteeing their ability to operate across the borders of host nations.” This implies that it could serve as a mechanism for the US to lead operations in Northeast Asia after OPCON transition. At the “ROK-US Combined Policy Forum” hosted by the Combined Forces Command last December, there was also a proposal to establish a US “Northeast Asia Combat Command” in Seoul. However, US Forces Korea stated, “We are aware of the report, but it reflects the views of the authors and does not represent the official position of the United Nations Command, the Combined Forces Command, or US Forces Korea.” (이들은 동북아사령부가 있으면 한미 전작권 전환 후에도 “미군 지휘 계통이 한국과 일본에 있는 미군에 대한 권한을 행사할 수 있으며, 이들이 주둔국의 경계를 넘어 작전할 수 있도록 보장할 수 있다”고 했다. 전작권 전환 후 미군이 동북아 작전을 주도할 장치가 될 수 있다는 뜻이다. 작년 12월 연합사 주최로 열린 ‘한미 연합정책포럼’에서도 서울에 미군의 ‘동북아 전투사령부’를 창설해야 한다는 주장이 나왔다. 다만 주한미군 측은 “해당 보고서를 인지하고 있다”면서도 “이는 저자들의 견해를 반영한 것이며 유엔사, 연합사 또는 주한미군의 공식 입장을 대변하지 않는다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Cyberattacks on National Election Commission Already Exceed 100,000 This Year… N. Korea's Attempts Surge 68-Fold ([단독] 선관위 해킹 공격 올해 벌써 10만건… 北 시도 68배 늘어)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Cyberattacks on National Election Commission Already Exceed 100,000 This Year… N. Korea's Attempts Surge 68-Fold ([단독] 선관위 해킹 공격 올해 벌써 10만건… 北 시도 68배 늘어)

The number of cyberattacks on the National Election Commission (NEC) has already surpassed 100,000 in the first half of this year alone, marking an all-time high. North Korea's cyberattacks have skyrocketed 68-fold from 52 cases last year to 3,543 cases in the first half of this year. (중앙선거관리위원회에 대한 사이버 공격 건수가 올해 상반기에만 벌써 10만건을 돌파한 것으로 나타났다. 역대 최대 수치다. 북한의 사이버 공격은 지난해 52건에서 올해 상반기 3543건으로 68배 폭증했다.)

According to the "Status of Cyberattacks on the NEC" obtained by the office of Rep. Shin Dong-wook of the People Power Party on the 24th, attempts to attack the NEC's website, servers, and systems totaled 101,179 from January to the 18th of this month. The NEC explains that cyberattacks typically increase during election years. However, compared to 39,896 attacks in 2022, when the 20th presidential election and the 8th local elections were held consecutively, and 47,140 attacks last year, which included the 21st presidential election, this year's figure has increased significantly. <<> By Internet Protocol (IP) addresses involved in the cyberattacks, the countries with the highest numbers were the United States (17,884 cases), Vietnam (6,084 cases), India (5,719 cases), North Korea (3,543 cases), Turkey (3,303 cases), and the Philippines (2,668 cases). Last year, the top countries were the United States (15,514 cases), China (4,414 cases), India (3,164 cases), and domestic (1,998 cases). It is suggested that hackers may have changed the bypass IPs used for cyberattacks, causing a decrease in China and an increase in Vietnam and others. <<> Regarding the surge in attacks this year, the NEC said, "Hackers are increasingly using AI automation tools, which has led to a sharp rise in the number of attempts." It added, "While there were many attempts, they did not result in actual hacking that damaged the election system." <<> However, with about 40 days left until the last presidential election on April 23, the NEC's election statistics system on its website was targeted by a cyberattack. Additionally, a joint security inspection by the National Intelligence Service and others in 2023 revealed North Korean cyberattack incidents and vulnerabilities in the NEC's voting and counting systems and internal networks. <<> Rep. Shin Dong-wook, a member of the National Assembly's special committee for the NEC's parliamentary investigation, said, "This is a stark example of why public trust in the NEC is low." He added, "Through this parliamentary investigation into the deprivation of suffrage rights, we will thoroughly clarify responsibility and ensure that measures to address cyberattacks and responses are included in the reform plans for the NEC." (24일 국민의힘 신동욱 의원실이 확보한 ‘중앙선관위 사이버 공격 현황’에 따르면 선관위 홈페이지나 서버, 시스템 등에 대한 사이버 공격 시도 건수는 올해 1월부터 이달 18일까지 총 10만1179건에 달했다. 보통 선거가 있는 해에 사이버 공격 건수가 증가한다는 게 선관위 설명이다. 하지만 20대 대선, 제8회 지방선거가 잇따라 실시된 2022년의 3만9896건, 21대 대선이 있었던 지난해 4만7140건과 비교해서도 올해는 눈에 띄게 늘었다.)

item.title: Lee Boarding Self-Propelled Howitzer on Yeonpyeong Island… “Minimize Conscription, Introduce Selective Volunteer System” (연평도서 자주포 탑승한 李… “징집 최소화 하고, 선택적 모병제로”)
item.description:
Lee Boarding Self-Propelled Howitzer on Yeonpyeong Island… “Minimize Conscription, Introduce Selective Volunteer System” (연평도서 자주포 탑승한 李… “징집 최소화 하고, 선택적 모병제로”)

On the 24th, marking the Korean War Week and the Month of National Heroes and Patriots, President Lee Jae-myung visited the Marine Corps’ Yeonpyeong Unit on Yeonpyeong Island in Ongjin County, Incheon, where he boarded a K9A1 self-propelled howitzer and demonstrated aiming a K6 machine gun. During a lunch meeting with service members that day, President Lee stated, “As I have promised several times, we will minimize conscripted soldiers and change the system so that people can choose the military as their career through voluntary enlistment.” He added, “What we aim for is a selective volunteer system, where individuals can either choose to become professional soldiers receiving sufficient pay within the budget limits or, if they prefer, serve under short-term conscription.” (24일 6·25 전쟁 주간과 호국 보훈의 달을 맞아 인천 옹진군 연평도의 해병대 연평부대를 방문한 이재명 대통령이 K9A1 자주포에 직접 탑승해 K6 기관총을 조준 시연하고 있다. 이 대통령은 이날 장병들과의 오찬 간담회에서 “여러 차례 약속했듯 징집병들을 최소화하고, 모병을 통해서 자기 자신의 직장으로 군을 선택할 수 있게 바꿔 나가겠다”며 “우리가 하려는 것은 선택적 모병제로, 예산의 허용 범위 내에서 충분한 보수를 지급받는 직업군인을 선택하든지 혹은 그게 싫으면 단기 징병에 응하는 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Formalizes Re-election Bid… Pro-Myung Faction: "Is This a Declaration of All-Out War?" (정청래, 연임 도전 공식화… 친명 “전면전 가겠다는 건가”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae Formalizes Re-election Bid… Pro-Myung Faction: "Is This a Declaration of All-Out War?" (정청래, 연임 도전 공식화… 친명 “전면전 가겠다는 건가”)

Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, resigned from his party leadership position on the 24th, stating, "I am aware of the fervent wishes of the people and party members. I will not stop the engine of reform," formalizing his bid for re-election as party leader. Within the pro-Myung faction, voices emerged saying, "Although the president indirectly sent messages several times to refrain from running, Jung's decision to run ultimately signals a move toward all-out war." With the August 17 party convention to elect the next Democratic Party leader approaching, divisions within the ruling camp are expected to accelerate. <<> During the Supreme Council meeting that day, Jung shouted President Lee Jae-myung's name 36 times, declaring, "No matter what anyone says, the one who will protect President Lee to the end is me, Jung Cheong-rae." This was interpreted as a message aimed at the pro-Myung faction, which has been demanding that he not run in the party convention amid accountability for the defeat in the Seoul mayoral election. The president himself recently made remarks in a press conference that seemed to attribute the election results and subsequent approval rating declines to Jung Cheong-rae's leadership. <<> Within the Democratic Party, calls for Jung not to run continued on that day. A pro-Myung lawmaker urged Jung to make a decision, saying, "If Jung is elected, the president's power will inevitably weaken significantly." However, Jung is reportedly set to make an official declaration for the party convention candidacy soon. <<> The Democratic Party leadership election is expected to be a three-way race between Jung, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok backed by the pro-Myung faction, and lawmaker Song Young-gil. Prime Minister Kim plans to announce his bid for party leadership later this month or in early July, after the process of appointing his successor as prime minister concludes. A key pro-Myung insider said, "Prime Minister Kim and lawmaker Song will unite as an anti-Jung front." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 24일 당대표직을 사퇴하면서 “국민과 당원의 절절한 바람을 알고 있다. 개혁의 엔진을 멈추지 않겠다”며 당대표 연임 도전을 공식화했다. 친명계에선 “대통령이 여러차례 불출마하라는 메시지를 간접적으로 보냈는데도 정 대표가 출마하는 건 결국 전면전으로 가겠다는 뜻”이라는 말이 나왔다. 민주당 차기 당대표를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 여권 분열이 가속화할 전망이다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "We Must Build Homes Without Hesitation, Need for Extraordinary Measures" (김용범 “닥치고 주택 지어야, 특단의 대책 논의 필요”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "We Must Build Homes Without Hesitation, Need for Extraordinary Measures" (김용범 “닥치고 주택 지어야, 특단의 대책 논의 필요”)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the Presidential Office's Policy Planning, stated on the 24th regarding real estate supply measures, "We must build (homes) without hesitation," adding, "We need to discuss extraordinary measures for this." During a debate at the Gwanhun Club held at the Seoul Press Center that day, Kim said, "Because supply-related companies suffered from PF (project financing) and high interest rates in 2023-2024, supply decreased by 30-40% compared to previous years. The results are now manifesting." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 24일 부동산 공급 대책과 관련해 “닥치고 (주택을) 지어야 한다”며 “이를 위한 특단의 방안을 논의해야 한다”고 말했다. 김 실장은 이날 서울 프레스센터에서 열린 관훈토론회에서 “2023~2024년 PF(프로젝트 파이낸싱)와 고금리로 공급 관련 회사들이 고통을 겪었기 때문에 예년보다 30~40% 공급이 덜 됐다. 그 결과가 지금 온 것”이라면서 이렇게 말했다.)

Kim noted, "The housing issue is my biggest concern and a difficult problem," adding, "There are many closed schools, and we are thoroughly searching every possible site owned by the public sector that can be used for housing construction." He also said, "In some Seoul areas like Yeongdeungpo and Guro, many former semi-industrial zones still remain," and stressed, "The central government and Seoul City need to put their heads together to discuss entirely new, extraordinary measures for supply plans." He added, "We aim to hear truly diverse opinions, including from those with direct interests and members of mom cafes," and continued, "If necessary, we will hold public debates to carefully decide on policies." <<> Regarding reforms to housing transaction taxes and holding taxes, Kim said, "It varies by country; even in the US, holding taxes differ by state," and noted, "Considering the unique characteristics of each country's system, we will aim to set (Korea's system) at a level that people can accept." The government is reviewing measures to strengthen housing holding taxes and capital gains taxes through its July tax reform proposal. (김 실장은 “주택 문제는 저의 제일 걱정거리이자 어려운 문제”라며 “폐교들도 많고, 공공 분야가 가진 부지 중에 주택을 지을 수 있는 쪽은 샅샅이 다 찾으려 한다”고 했다. 또 “영등포나 구로 등 서울 일부 지역엔 과거 준공업 지역 단지들이 여전히 많이 남아 있다”며 “중앙정부와 서울시가 머리를 맞대고 공급 방안에 대해 완전히 새로운 특단의 대책을 논의해야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “직접적인 이해관계를 가진 분들, 맘카페 회원 등도 포함해 정말 다양한 의견을 들으려 한다”며 “필요하면 공개 토론도 거쳐서 신중하게 정책을 결정하려 한다”고 했다.)

On the recent decline in the presidential approval rating, Kim stated, "I don't think it has moved significantly due to the stance on labor, tax, and housing policies." Regarding new nuclear power plants, he hinted at the possibility of additional construction, saying, "I believe there will be serious discussions in the 12th Basic Plan for Electricity Supply and Demand." (주택 거래세와 보유세 개편 방안에 대해선 “나라마다 다르고, 미국의 경우에도 주마다 다른 게 보유세”라며 “나라마다 제도의 특성이 있는 걸 감안해, (한국도) 납득할 수 있는 수준으로 정하려 한다”고 했다. 정부는 7월 세제개편안을 통해 주택 보유세와 양도세를 강화하는 방안을 검토 중이다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil Likely to Declare Candidacy by End of Month (김민석·송영길, 이르면 이달말 출마 선언)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil Likely to Declare Candidacy by End of Month (김민석·송영길, 이르면 이달말 출마 선언)

With Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae officially announcing his bid for a second term as party leader on the 24th, other leadership contenders, including Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil, are reportedly set to declare their candidacies for the August 17th national convention to elect the next party leader as early as late June or at the latest early July. (민주당 정청래 대표가 24일 당대표 연임 도전을 공식화한 가운데, 또 다른 당권 주자인 김민석 국무총리와 송영길 의원도 이르면 6월 말, 늦어도 7월 초 차기 당대표를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회 출마 선언에 나설 것으로 알려졌다.)

Prime Minister Kim returned home late that night after concluding a three-day, two-night business trip to China, his final overseas trip in his role as prime minister. Kim is expected to resign as prime minister around the end of this month or early July, following the completion of the appointment process for his successor, nominee Han Seong-sook, and then announce his candidacy for party leader. The appointment of Prime Minister Han will proceed through a two-day parliamentary confirmation hearing starting on the 25th, followed by a full parliamentary vote between the ruling and opposition parties and the president's approval. A source close to the ruling party stated, "Every Democratic Party member knows that Prime Minister Kim has President Lee Jae-myung's backing," adding, "Once he formally declares his candidacy, Kim will emphasize that he is the only one fit to be party leader for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." However, he is also expected to highlight issues demanded by hardline supporters, such as abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers. <<> Ahead of the national convention, Prime Minister Kim has recently made several visits to Honam, where 30% of Democratic Party members reside. He attended events in South Jeolla Province and Gwangju on the 16th, 17th, and 19th, which coincided with the president's European tour. Notably, it is known that his elderly mother lives in Iksan, North Jeolla Province, and he frequently visits there on weekends. A source from Prime Minister Kim's side said, "He will continue to think of and visit Honam as a second hometown." <<> Lawmaker Song Young-gil, who is currently on a trip to the United States as a special envoy of the National Assembly Speaker, is reportedly set to officially declare his candidacy shortly after returning on the 27th by holding a town hall meeting. On the 30th, he plans to pay respects at the grave of former President Roh Moo-hyun in Bongha Village, South Gyeongsang Province. Ahead of his bid for the national convention, Song had a private dinner with President Lee on the 18th, where he reportedly expressed his intention to run for party leader. Democratic Party lawmaker Park Jie-won appeared on CBS Radio and said, "I heard that during the dinner, Song spoke to the president about the national convention and pitched a plan to enter a three-way race and eventually unite with Prime Minister Kim, leading to a convergence in the runoff vote." A source from Song's side noted, "While some speculate that after supporting Prime Minister Kim, Song might be appointed as foreign minister, Song is considering challenging for party leadership due to strong calls for him to run, especially from Honam," adding, "Once the leadership race begins and support for Song rises, it would be hard for him to back out, wouldn't it?" (김 총리는 이날 밤 2박 3일간의 중국 출장을 마치고 귀국했다. 총리로서 마지막 해외 출장이었다. 김 총리는 후임인 한성숙 총리 후보자의 임명 절차가 끝나는 이달 말 또는 7월 초 총리직을 사퇴한 뒤 당대표 출마 선언을 할 것으로 전해졌다. 한 총리 임명 절차는 오는 25일부터 이틀간 진행되는 국회 인사청문회 이후 여야의 국회 본회의 표결을 거쳐 대통령 재가로 마무리된다. 여권 관계자는 “김 총리가 이재명 대통령 지원을 받고 있다는 것은 민주당 당원이라면 다 아는 사실”이라며 “김 총리는 출마를 공식화하면 이재명 정부 성공을 위한 당대표 적임자는 본인뿐이라는 점을 강조할 것”이라고 했다. 다만 강성 지지층이 요구하는 검찰 보완수사권 폐지 등도 강조할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae, Who Chanted "Loyalty to President Lee" in the Morning, Visited Moon in the Afternoon (오전에 “李대통령과 의리” 외친 정청래, 오후에 文 찾아갔다)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, Who Chanted "Loyalty to President Lee" in the Morning, Visited Moon in the Afternoon (오전에 “李대통령과 의리” 외친 정청래, 오후에 文 찾아갔다)

The decision by Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae to formally announce his bid for re-election on the 24th is expected to deepen fractures within the ruling party. On this day, Jung resigned as party leader, shouting President Lee Jae-myung's name 36 times, and humbly described himself as "a political destiny community and a single body with President Lee," as well as "a comrade and a fellow warrior." However, the pro-Lee faction remarked, "With Jung's candidacy in the August party convention, the party has split into two factions and is now engaged in a civil war just one year after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration." Notably, since the next party leader will hold the power to nominate candidates for the 2028 general elections, fierce competition is expected. (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 24일 연임 도전을 공식화하면서 여권 내 균열이 더욱 커질 전망이다. 정 대표는 이날 당대표직을 사퇴하면서 이재명 대통령의 이름을 36차례나 외치고 “이 대통령과 저는 정치적 운명공동체이자 한몸 공동체” “동지이자 전우”라며 몸을 한껏 낮췄다. 하지만 친명계는 “정 대표의 8월 전당대회 출마로 이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 당이 두 쪽으로 쪼개져 내전을 벌이게 됐다”고 했다. 특히 차기 당대표는 2028년 총선 공천권을 쥐게 되는 만큼 치열한 경쟁이 예상된다.)

During the party's supreme council meeting that day, Jung stated, "I will do my utmost in my current position for the success of the Lee Jae-myung government. Even if that path is a thorny and arduous one, I will only follow the public sentiment and the party's will, walking my own path." Although Jung did not explicitly mention his candidacy for the party convention, his aides said, "By resigning with his term still running through August, he has effectively confirmed his bid for re-election." (정 대표는 이날 당 최고위원회의에서 “저는 이재명 정부의 성공을 위해 제가 서 있는 위치에서 최선을 다하겠다”며 “그 길이 비록 험난한 고난의 가시밭길일지라도 오직 민심, 오직 당심만 보고 저의 길을 가겠다”고 했다. 정 대표는 전당대회 출마 여부는 언급하지 않았지만, 정 대표 측근들은 “8월까지 대표 임기가 남아있는 상황에서 사퇴 의사를 밝힌 건 연임 도전을 기정사실화한 것”이라고 했다.)

In his roughly 17-minute speech that day, Jung mentioned "Lee Jae-myung" a total of 36 times. Jung asserted, "If President Lee succeeds, I succeed too, so don't worry. I will uphold the success of the Lee Jae-myung government and my loyalty to the president until the end." A key figure in the pro-Lee faction said, "This is a highly strategic move—continuing to send messages to the hardcore supporters while avoiding a confrontation with the president. However, the fact that Jung has caused 'Myung-Cheong conflict' over the past ten months as party leader remains an undeniable fact." (정 대표는 이날 약 17분의 발언 동안 ‘이재명’을 총 36회 언급했다. 정 대표는 “이 대통령이 성공해야 저도 성공한다. 그러니 걱정하지 말라”며 “이재명 정부의 성공, 이 대통령과의 의리는 제가 끝까지 지킨다”고 했다. 친명계 핵심 인사는 “강성 지지층을 향한 메시지를 계속 내면서도 이 대통령과 각을 세우지 않는 고도의 전략”이라며 “하지만 정 대표가 지난 10개월간 당대표를 하면서 ‘명청 갈등’을 일으켜온 건 사라지지 않는 팩트”라고 했다.)

The conflict between the party and the presidency reached its peak following the June 3 local elections, where the party failed to reclaim the Seoul mayoral seat, coinciding with the Democratic Party's leadership election. In two recent press conferences, President Lee targeted Jung's leadership over the election results and subsequent approval rating drops, saying, "We lost where we should have won," and "The policy direction hasn't changed, but approval ratings are falling." Notably, the president did not invite Jung to a departure event for his European tour on the 9th, and Jung even remarked, "Regimes are short-lived, but the people are eternal." The pro-Lee faction pressured Jung, saying, "The president's intention is for Jung to withdraw his candidacy," but with Jung deciding to run that day, the conflict between the two sides is expected to intensify. (당청 갈등은 서울시장 탈환에 실패한 6·3 지방선거 이후 민주당 당대표 선거와 맞물리면서 극에 달했다. 이 대통령은 최근 두 차례 기자회견에서 선거 결과와 이후 지지율 하락에 대해 “이겨야 하는 곳에서 졌다” “국정 기조는 바뀌지 않았는데 지지율은 떨어지고 있다”며 정청래 지도부를 겨냥했다. 특히 대통령은 지난 9일 유럽 순방 출국길 행사에 정 대표를 부르지 않았고, 정 대표도 “정권은 짧고 국민은 영원하다”는 발언까지 했다. 친명계는 “대통령의 뜻은 정 대표의 출마 포기”라고 압박했지만, 이날 정 대표가 출마를 결정하면서 양측 간 갈등은 심화될 전망이다.)

Within the pro-Lee faction, reactions emerged such as, "If he truly intends to uphold loyalty to the president, wouldn't it be right to not run, as the president wishes?" Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu directly criticized Jung, saying, "The Democratic Party is on the same boat as the Lee Jae-myung government. There can't be two captains on this ship." Lawmaker Lee Ki-heon wrote on Facebook, "I understand Jung is feeling resentful and hurt. But stepping back now is the best way to protect the president and save the party." One pro-Lee lawmaker stated, "We must be prepared for a psychological split of the party." (친명계에선 “대통령과의 의리를 정말 지키겠다면 대통령 뜻대로 불출마하는 게 맞는 것 아니냐”는 반응이 나왔다. 강득구 최고위원은 “민주당은 이재명 정부와 한 배를 타고 있다. 배의 선장이 둘일 수 없다”며 정 대표를 직격했다. 이기헌 의원은 페이스북 글에서 ”정 대표가 많이 억울하고 아프실 줄 안다. 하지만 지금 한 걸음 물러서는 것이 대통령을 지키고 당을 구하는 최선의 방법“이라고 했다. 친명계 한 의원은 “심리적 분당까지 각오해야 하는 상황”이라고 했다.)

Among pro-Lee supporters, the fact that Jung met with former President Moon Jae-in shortly after his resignation announcement was also criticized as "a blatant message to rally the pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions to win." The recent conflict between pro-Lee and pro-Jung camps has been evolving into a struggle between the new mainstream "New Lee Jae-myung" and the pro-Roh/pro-Moon factions, and many found it uncomfortable when Jung staged a "two-shot" scene with former President Moon. The meeting took place when Moon attended the Seoul International Book Fair opening at COEX in Gangnam, Seoul, and Jung visited him there. Jung wrote on Facebook, "I told him that as my reason for resigning, I said, 'We must nourish ourselves with the history of Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in to bloom Lee Jae-myung's history.' He kept patting my back and seemed pleased, saying, 'Well done.'" (친명 지지층에선 정 대표가 사퇴 발표 직후 문재인 전 대통령과 만난 것을 두고도 “친노·친문 세력을 결집해 이기겠다는 노골적 메시지”라는 말이 나왔다. 최근 친명·친청 갈등은 신주류 ‘뉴이재명’과 친노·친문 등 세력 간 싸움으로 번지는 양상인데, 정 대표가 문 전 대통령과 ‘투샷’ 장면을 연출하자 불편하다는 것이다. 이날 만남은 문 전 대통령이 서울 강남 코엑스에서 개막하는 서울국제도서전에 참석했는데 정 대표가 이곳을 찾으면서 성사됐다. 정 대표는 페이스북 글에서 “대표직 사퇴의 변으로 ‘김대중과 노무현, 문재인의 역사를 자양분 삼아 이재명의 역사를 꽃피워야 한다’는 말을 했다고 말씀드렸더니 등을 계속 토닥거려 주시면서 ‘잘했다’라며 흡족해 하셨다”고 했다.)

That day, Jung also posted his resignation statement on the free bulletin board of pro-government YouTuber Kim Eo-jun's Ddanzi Ilbo, a site frequented by pro-Roh and pro-Moon supporters. The post received comments like, "Keep pushing forward and definitely seek re-election," and "I unconditionally support you." Jung has posted on this site three times just this month. (정 대표는 이날 친노·친문 지지자들이 주로 찾는 친여 유튜버 김어준씨의 딴지일보 자유게시판에 당대표 사퇴문을 올리기도 했다. 이 글에는 “끝까지 밀고 나가서 꼭 연임해야 한다” “무조건 지지한다”는 등의 댓글이 이어졌다. 정 대표는 이달 들어서만 이곳에 세 번 글을 올렸다.)

The division among ruling party supporters is also leading to splits among pro-government YouTubers. Kim Eo-jun, who supported Jung in last August's party leadership election, said on his broadcast on the 23rd, regarding the drop in President Lee's approval ratings, "This is a loss of the 'core' support base." He added, "Some pro-Lee supporters think pro-Moon is no longer needed and can be replaced with New Lee Jae-myung, but that's a huge miscalculation. Cutting out pro-Moon means cutting out pro-Lee." In contrast, pro-Lee YouTuber Lee Dong-hyung retorted, "If you waver, are you a core supporter? You're wavering because you're a soft supporter." (여권 지지층 분열은 친여 유튜버들의 균열로도 이어지고 있다. 작년 8월 당대표 선거 때 정 대표를 지원했던 김어준씨는 지난 23일 방송에서 이 대통령 지지율 하락을 두고 “이건 ‘코어(핵심)’ 지지층이 빠진 것”이라며 “(친명 지지층 일부는) 친문은 이제 필요 없고 뉴이재명으로 대체할 수 있다고 생각하지만 엄청난 오산이다. 친문을 쳐낸다는 건 친명을 쳐내는 것”이라고 했다. 반면 친명계 유튜버 이동형씨는 “흔들리면 코어층이냐, 연성 지지자니까 흔들리는 것”이라고 반박했다.)

item.title: The Crisis-Hit Rebuilding Korea Party: Removing "Cho Kuk" from Its Name (위기의 조국혁신당, 간판서 조국 이름 지우나)
item.description:
The Crisis-Hit Rebuilding Korea Party: Removing "Cho Kuk" from Its Name (위기의 조국혁신당, 간판서 조국 이름 지우나)

The Rebuilding Korea Party, facing its greatest crisis since its founding following former leader Cho Kuk's failed bid to enter the National Assembly, has seen internal calls to change its name. The proposal is to remove "Cho Kuk" from the Rebuilding Korea Party's title. (조국혁신당이 조국 전 대표의 국회 입성 실패로 창당 이후 최대 위기를 맞은 가운데, 당내에서 당명 변경 주장까지 나왔다. 조국혁신당에서 ‘조국’을 빼자는 것이다.)

Floor leader Kim Joon-hyung said in a YTN radio interview on the 23rd that "amending the party name is something worth considering." Kim noted, "During the general election, former leader Cho stirred up a whirlwind and rallied support, aided by the party name," but added, "It's both our strength and our weakness." A source from the ruling party stated, "There have been many criticisms that the inclusion of 'Cho Kuk' in the name, such as being called the 'Cho Kuk Party' instead of the official abbreviation 'Rebuilding Party,' has limited its appeal." However, no formal discussion on the party name has yet taken place. Some members of the Rebuilding Korea Party have reportedly opposed the idea, saying, "How can you talk about the Rebuilding Korea Party without Cho Kuk?" <<> Since Cho's defeat in the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, the Rebuilding Korea Party has been continuously criticizing the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party. It demanded the withdrawal of what it called "anti-reform figures" after President Lee appointed a series of former prosecutors to the Blue House shortly after the election, specifically targeting Han Chan-shik, the senior secretary for civil affairs, who oversaw the investigation into the Moon Jae-in government's "blacklist case." Acting party leader Shin Jang-sik, during a party meeting on that day, said regarding the establishment of a prosecution office and a major crimes investigation office under the abolition of the prosecution service, "The government and the ruling party are just pretending to do something they don't want to do. They're sitting idly, like watching someone else's grave-cleaning." The previous day, in a spokesperson's comment, the Rebuilding Korea Party also opposed the appointment of former People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Hee-gwan as president of the Korean Red Cross, labeling him a "figure who opposed the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol" and requesting the president reject the confirmation. A Democratic Party official remarked, "This is retaliation, tying us up over every little thing because the Democratic Party didn't yield in the Pyeongtaek-eul election." <<> Amid this, former leader Cho has been actively continuing his social media activities after his defeat. He has already visited the Honam region and posts multiple items on Facebook daily. There are also reactions within the party, such as, "Isn't former leader Cho returning too quickly?" (김준형 원내대표는 23일 오후 YTN라디오 인터뷰에서 “당명 개정도 생각해볼 문제”라고 했다. 김 원내대표는 “총선 때 조 전 대표가 돌풍을 일으키고 뭉칠 수 있었던 데에는 당명의 도움이 있었다”면서도 “우리의 장점이기도 하고 단점이기도 하다”고 했다. 여권 한 관계자는 “정식 약칭인 ‘혁신당’ 대신 ‘조국당’이라고 불리는 등 당명에 ‘조국’이 들어간 것 때문에 확장성이 떨어진다는 지적이 그동안 많았다”고 했다. 다만 아직 당에서 당명과 관련한 공식적인 논의는 하지 않았다. 조국혁신당 일부 당원들도 “조국을 빼고 조국혁신당을 얘기할 수가 있겠냐”며 반발하고 있다고 한다.)

item.title: Discharged Jang Dong-hyuk Dismisses Resignation Calls: “Party Leader’s Fate Decided by Party Members” (퇴원한 장동혁 “당대표 거취는 당원이 결정” 사퇴론 일축)
item.description:
Discharged Jang Dong-hyuk Dismisses Resignation Calls: “Party Leader’s Fate Decided by Party Members” (퇴원한 장동혁 “당대표 거취는 당원이 결정” 사퇴론 일축)

People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk was discharged from the hospital on the 24th, six days after being hospitalized for overwork, and returned to party duties. At a press conference held at the National Assembly, Jang dismissed internal calls for his resignation, stating, “The fate of the party leader is not a matter for a few lawmakers to decide, but for party members to decide.” Despite continued demands for his resignation after the local elections and pressure from newly elected floor leader Jung Jeom-sik, who sought to force a decision on his position, Jang maintained his original stance of not stepping down. <<> In the press conference, Jang said, “Our party is already struggling to fight against the Lee Jae-myung regime, yet we are exhausting our energy on worthless conflicts,” adding, “What party members truly want is for us to unite as one to stop the recklessness of the Lee Jae-myung regime and protect the country and its people.” He characterized the evaluation of the local elections and the controversy over his position as a “worthless conflict.” He further stated, “I will spare no effort to achieve the true conservative rebuilding that party members desire.” <<> Jang also mentioned “establishing party discipline,” saying, “The tasks of reforming the party and solidifying its discipline have become issues that can no longer be postponed.” A PPP official remarked, “It appears Jang has signaled that if demands for his resignation, which undermine his leadership, persist, he will actively respond by using the party leader’s disciplinary and personnel powers.” <<> Amid this, floor leader Jung reportedly gathered for lunch and dinner with fourth-term lawmakers on the same day and agreed that the controversy over Jang’s position should be concluded early. A participant said, “There was no disagreement between the mainstream and non-mainstream factions that Jang has lost the leadership to continue guiding the party,” adding, “We must also face the fact that the productive agendas Jang himself claims to pursue are being overshadowed by this issue of his position.” <<> In an interview with this newspaper the previous day, floor leader Jung stated, “I have already met with a fifth-term lawmaker. After listening to the opinions of fourth-term, third-term, second-term, and first-term lawmakers, if there is consensus that ‘a decision is needed,’ I will meet directly with Leader Jang to discuss it.” (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 과로로 입원한 지 엿새 만인 24일 퇴원해 당무에 복귀했다. 장 대표는 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “당대표의 거취는 몇몇 의원들이 결정할 문제가 아니라 당원들이 결정할 문제”라며 당내 사퇴 요구를 일축했다. 지방선거 이후 당대표 사퇴 요구가 이어지고 지난 10일 선출된 정점식 원내대표가 거취 결정을 압박에 나섰지만, 물러나지 않겠다는 기존 입장을 고수한 것이다.)

item.title: North Korean Soldier Defects, Crossing Minefields and Barbed Wire (지뢰·철책 뚫고 북한군 1명 귀순)
item.description:
North Korean Soldier Defects, Crossing Minefields and Barbed Wire (지뢰·철책 뚫고 북한군 1명 귀순)

A North Korean soldier defected to the South by crossing the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) along the central front on the 23rd, it was revealed on the 24th. Despite North Korea laying mines and erecting barbed wire fences as part of border fortification efforts since 2024, at least four individuals have defected in the past year alone. (북한군 1명이 23일 중부전선을 통해 군사분계선(MDL)을 월남해 귀순 의사를 밝힌 것으로 24일 나타났다. 북한은 2024년부터 국경선화 작업을 하며 지뢰를 묻고 철책을 세우고 있지만 지난 1년 동안에만 최소 4명이 귀순했다.)

The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) announced on the 24th that they secured one North Korean soldier in the Cheorwon-gun area of Gangwon Province on the night of the 23rd. The soldier expressed his intention to defect, and it is known that South Korean forces successfully conducted a defection-inducing operation around 10 p.m. The soldier is male, but his rank and other details have not been disclosed. The JCS stated, "Relevant authorities are investigating the specific details." No unusual movements from North Korea have been reported in connection with this incident so far. (합동참모본부는 23일 야간에 강원도 철원군 일대에서 북한군 1명의 신병을 확보했다고 24일 밝혔다. 해당 군인은 귀순 의사를 밝혔고, 오후 10시쯤 우리 군이 귀순 유도 작전을 성공적으로 진행한 것으로 알려졌다. 해당 군인은 남성으로 계급 등은 알려지지 않았다. 합참은 “관련 세부 사항에 대해서는 관계 기관에서 조사 중”이라고 설명했다. 현재까지 북한군은 이와 관련해 특이 동향은 없는 것으로 전해졌다.)

The area is known to have been fortified by North Korea with landmines and barbed wire fences. A military source explained, "Even when laying mines, they create pathways for movement. If the soldier knew these routes, it would have been possible to pass through the minefield." (해당 지역은 북한이 지뢰를 매설하고 철책을 세운 곳으로 알려졌다. 군 소식통은 “지뢰 매설 작업을 하더라도 이동을 위해 통로를 만들어 놓는데 해당 루트를 알고 있었다면 지뢰지대 통과가 가능했을 것”이라고 했다.)

This marks the fourth known defection case since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration. On July 3 last year, one male civilian crossed the MDL along the central-western front, and on July 31 of the same year, another male civilian defected through the Han River neutral zone. In October last year, a North Korean soldier crossed the MDL along the central front and expressed his intention to defect. This is the first defection of a North Korean soldier in eight months. (이재명 정부 출범 후 알려진 귀순 사례는 이번이 네 번째다. 지난해 7월 3일 남성 주민 1명이 중서부 전선 MDL을 넘어왔고, 같은 달 31일 또 다른 남성 주민 1명이 한강 중립 수역을 통해 귀순했다. 지난해 10월에는 북한군 1명이 중부전선 MDL을 넘어와 귀순 의사를 밝혔다. 북한 군인의 귀순은 8개월 만이다.)

Meanwhile, the United Nations Command (UNC), which determines violations of the Armistice Agreement, posted an article on the 24th titled "UNC Fact Sheet: DMZ Armistice Agreement Implementation and Recent North Korean Activities," stating that North Korea's installation of barbed wire fences and landmine laying north of the MDL "does not constitute a violation of the Armistice Agreement." (한편 정전협정 위반 여부를 판단하는 유엔군사령부는 24일 ‘유엔사 팩트시트: DMZ 정전협정 이행 및 최근 북한의 활동’이라는 게시물을 올리고 북한이 MDL 이북에서 철책 설치와 지뢰 매설을 하는 것은 “정전협정 위반이 아니다”라고 밝혔다.)

President Lee Jae-myung said last December, "North Korea, worried that the South might invade the North, is building triple-layered barbed wire fences along the MDL, erecting barriers to prevent tanks from crossing, and cutting off bridges and roads." This suggests that the fence installations are defensive in nature. In contrast, the Ministry of National Defense stated on the 22nd and 23rd that North Korea's activities near the MDL are violations of the Armistice Agreement. A ministry official said, "This is the first time we have stated this publicly, but the government has been viewing these actions as violations of the Armistice Agreement for some time." (이재명 대통령은 지난해 12월 “북한은 혹시 남쪽이 북침하지 않을까 걱정해서 (군사분계선에) 3중 철책을 치고 탱크라도 넘어올까 방벽을 쌓고 다리와 도로를 끊고 있다”고 했다. 철책 설치 등이 방어적 성격이란 취지다. 반면 국방부는 지난 22일과 23일 잇달아 북한의 MDL 일대 활동이 ‘정전협정 위반’이라는 입장을 밝혔다. 국방부 관계자는 “대외적으로 밝힌 것은 처음이지만 정부 차원에서는 이전부터 정전협정 위반으로 보고 있었던 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kang Kun-jik: "Without Securing Satellite Communication Networks, Wartime OPCON Becomes Hollow" (강건작 “위성 통신망 확보 못하면 전작권 공허해진다”)
item.description:
Kang Kun-jik: "Without Securing Satellite Communication Networks, Wartime OPCON Becomes Hollow" (강건작 “위성 통신망 확보 못하면 전작권 공허해진다”)

Kang Kun-jik, the newly appointed First Deputy Director of the National Security Office, who will oversee the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON) at the presidential office, stated, "If we fail to secure sovereignty over low-earth orbit satellite communication networks, data-based sources, the Korean version of MSS (an AI-based military intelligence analysis platform), and the actual operation of OPCON could all become hollow." In a presentation at the 'Hongneung Defense Forum' hosted by the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses (KIDA) on the 23rd, Deputy Director Kang wrote, "The pursuit of OPCON transition by successive South Korean governments is a declaration that the South Korean military will command war independently. However, if the South Korean military cannot independently control the data and algorithms that fill the screens on which commanders make decisions, OPCON cannot be complete. This is a notable aspect of the OPCON transition." He added this in his statement. <<> Last month, Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-back stated, "Even if OPCON is reclaimed tomorrow, there would be no major problem," and President Yoon emphasized early transition, saying, "It's not a big problem; it's no problem at all." However, the newly appointed Deputy Director Kang has expressed the stance that attention must be paid to aspects related to military AI in the OPCON transition process. <<> Deputy Director Kang, as a retired Army Lieutenant General, had planned to attend the Hongneung Defense Forum to present this stance, but after being appointed as the First Deputy Director of the National Security Office on the 21st, he did not attend. Nevertheless, his stance was disclosed on that day along with the presentations of other attendees. <<> In his presentation, Deputy Director Kang focused on the military AI currently being developed by the U.S. military. He stated, "The U.S. Forces Korea's military AI is not shared with the South Korean military. The core value of an AI battlefield system is not the platform itself, but the real-time data collected by the U.S. military's own based sources, such as satellites, drones, and signal intelligence, which are fused into that platform." He added, "Full access to this platform by an ally would directly expose the U.S. military's based source assets. This is a condition that cannot be met in any alliance relationship. This is the reason why a Korean-style MSS must be built based on South Korean military based sources." He emphasized the stance that for South Korean-led defense on the Korean Peninsula, it is necessary to build a Korean-style MSS based on independent information assets. <<> Deputy Director Kang raised the issue of our capability shortcomings, stating, "The logic that creating a Korean version of MSS, an AI battlefield platform, solves all problems also has loopholes. We can make the bowl. The question is whether there is water to fill that bowl." He emphasized that based source data—such as satellite imagery, signal intelligence, and drone detection data—must be built together with a data pipeline that connects them in real time. Otherwise, he pointed out, the battlefield AI would be nothing more than an "analysis engine without data." <<> Deputy Director Kang argued that our military should focus more on substance than on systems. He stated, "Currently, the South Korean military's independent communication capabilities cannot integrate real-time data, and the sensor data of each unit and each service branch are fragmented. Without one of the three—the battlefield AI platform, the based source data collection system, and the hyper-connected communication network—it is difficult for the other two to be converted into meaningful actual combat power." <<> Deputy Director Kang said, "We must note that the practical meaning of military sovereignty lies not in the completion of institutional frameworks, but in the independent internalization of data capabilities, hyper-connected communication, and AI software sovereignty." He also asserted that current security discourse in South Korea remains focused on platforms like the KF-21 and nuclear-powered submarines, but issues such as the vision for hyper-connected communication and securing low-earth orbit satellite communication must rise to the level of national discourse, just like these matters. <<> In response to a question from this newspaper about whether he had shown a cautious stance on the early OPCON transition, Deputy Director Kang said, "That is not the case," adding, "OPCON transition could have been done 10 years ago, and there would have been no problem then either. Would it be a problem if it were done tomorrow?" He explained, "The gist of the presentation is that if we don't prepare now for the future situation where data construction, communication technology, and AI become important, the purpose of reclaiming OPCON will be diluted." In response, a source familiar with OPCON discussions commented, "It is contradictory for Deputy Director Kang to acknowledge the South Korean military's insufficient readiness for military AI and similar issues while pushing forward with the early OPCON transition. It is necessary to pay attention to the rapidly changing security situation, including North Korea's nuclear threats." (청와대에서 전시작전통제권 전환 업무를 총괄하게 될 강건작 신임 국가안보실 1차장이 “저궤도 위성 통신망의 주권을 확보하지 못하면 데이터 기반 소스도 한국판 MSS(AI 기반 군사 정보 분석 플랫폼)도 전작권의 실질 작동도 모두 공허해질 수 있다”는 입장을 밝혔다. 강 차장은 23일 한국국방연구원(KIDA)이 주최한 ‘홍릉 국방포럼’의 발표문에서 “한국의 역대 정부가 추구하고 있는 전작권 전환은 한국군이 스스로 전쟁을 지휘하겠다는 선언”이라며 “그런데 지휘관이 판단을 내리는 화면을 채우는 데이터와 알고리즘을 한국군이 스스로 통제하지 못한다면, 전작권은 완전할 수 없다. 이것이 전작권 전환의 주목할 측면”이라며 이같이 썼다.)

item.title: Former pro-Yoon supporters without a focal point… Oh Se-hoon and Han Dong-hoon are 'building their own camps' (구심점 없는 옛 친윤… 오세훈·한동훈 ‘내편 만들기’)
item.description:
Former pro-Yoon supporters without a focal point… Oh Se-hoon and Han Dong-hoon are 'building their own camps' (구심점 없는 옛 친윤… 오세훈·한동훈 ‘내편 만들기’)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon (Busan North Gap) are expanding their outreach to former pro-Yoon lawmakers within the People Power Party (PPP). The former pro-Yoon faction, which forms the mainstream of the PPP, has been left without a clear leadership focal point since the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk-yeol. Some in political circles interpret this as "the start of a full-fledged competition for leadership within the conservative camp ahead of the 2028 general election." <<>> Mayor Oh attended a lecture invitation from the 'Future Innovation Forum', a parliamentary research group, on the 24th. The Future Innovation Forum is a group initiated by senior former pro-Yoon lawmakers of the PPP. During his lecture on the theme 'Restoring conservative values and the future', Mayor Oh stated, "While it may seem satisfying when someone fights hard in ordinary times, the one who actually wins the election at the decisive moment is the true filial son." This was interpreted as a critique of PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who appeals only to hardcore supporters. <<>> Regarding Jang’s position as party leader, Mayor Oh said, "A collective consensus among lawmakers is gradually forming from the grassroots," adding, "The time has come for senior lawmakers to play a significant role in a weighty manner." The lecture was attended by 28 PPP lawmakers, including floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik and lawmakers Kim Ki-hyun, Kim Seok-ki, Kim Jeong-jae, Yoon Han-hong, and Park Soo-young. A significant number of the attending lawmakers were from the former pro-Yoon faction. <<>> Mayor Oh is being assessed as expanding his sphere of activity into 'Yeouido political circles' following the local elections. He has scheduled dinner meetings with PPP lawmakers from the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee and Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee until the end of this month, and plans to meet with floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik next month. He also plans to meet with Seoul-area lawmakers who supported his mayoral election bid. A PPP lawmaker said, "Mayor Oh was relatively perceived as lacking in personal connections with lawmakers, but he appears to be aiming to secure allies within the party, including the pro-Yoon faction, with an eye on the 2030 presidential election." <<>> Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon is also extensively contacting PPP lawmakers, including those from the former pro-Yoon faction. The bill to amend the Board of Audit and Inspection Act, which Han first proposed after being elected as a lawmaker, was co-signed by 31 lawmakers, including former pro-Yoon figures such as Yoon Sang-hyun, Yoon Jae-ok, Park Dae-chul, Kim Dae-sik, and Seo Cheon-ho. Han had previously joined the 'Future Innovation Forum' at the suggestion of lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun’s side. <<>> During his tenure as PPP party leader, Han faced fierce criticism from the pro-Yoon faction due to his conflict with then-President Yoon. After the impeachment motion against former President Yoon passed in the National Assembly, the pro-Yoon faction demanded his resignation as party leader and tacitly allowed party leader Jang Dong-hyuk to expel Han over the 'party member bulletin board' issue. Among the former pro-Yoon faction, there is considerable negative sentiment regarding Han’s reinstatement into the party. <<>> However, a senior lawmaker from the Yeongnam region reported, "Since Han was elected in the by-election, voices within the pro-Yoon faction are emerging that 'we must fight the next general election alongside Han.'" Han reportedly held a private meeting on the 21st with PPP lawmakers from Busan districts, including Kim Do-eup, Lee Seong-kwon, Kim Dae-sik, Kwak Kyu-taek, and Jeong Seong-guk. On the 23rd, he also attended a forum on 'Electoral System Reform' hosted by PPP lawmaker Lee Seong-kwon (Busan Saha Gap). Han’s side has stated, "If they are willing to join the conservative reconstruction, we will work with anyone regardless of past factional ties." <<>> Among the 110 PPP lawmakers, the mainstream—including the former pro-Yoon faction—is estimated to number around 60. They lost their focal point after former President Yoon was impeached. While they were known to have supported party leader Jang Dong-hyuk during last year’s party convention, many assessed that they failed to form a unified front. However, following the recent local elections, the former pro-Yoon faction appears to be turning its attention to Mayor Oh and lawmaker Han. An opposition figure commented, "With nomination for the general election at stake depending on who seizes leadership of the conservative camp, the former pro-Yoon faction is also approaching Mayor Oh and Han from a practical standpoint." <<>> There is also a perspective that tensions between Mayor Oh and lawmaker Han have begun in earnest as they seek to co-opt the mainstream of the PPP. Mayor Oh was absent from the 'Electoral System Reform' forum on the 23rd, where both were expected to attend. Conversely, lawmaker Han did not attend the Future Innovation Forum on the same day, where Mayor Oh was the lecturer. item.title: Trump Extends North Korea National Emergency for One Year, Citing 'Ongoing Grave Threat' of Nuclear and Missile Programs (트럼프, ‘대북 국가비상사태’ 1년 연장… “핵·미사일 위협 여전히 심각”)
item.description:
Trump Extends North Korea National Emergency for One Year, Citing 'Ongoing Grave Threat' of Nuclear and Missile Programs (트럼프, ‘대북 국가비상사태’ 1년 연장… “핵·미사일 위협 여전히 심각”)

U.S. President Donald Trump announced a one-year extension of the national emergency regarding North Korea, stating that its nuclear and missile programs continue to pose an extraordinary and serious threat to national security, foreign policy, and the economy. According to a notice published in the Federal Register, Trump said, "The risk of proliferation of weapons-grade fissile material on the Korean Peninsula, and the actions and policies of the North Korean government, continue to present an extraordinary and serious threat," and notified that the national emergency, which serves as the basis for sanctions on North Korea, will remain in effect after June 26. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 북한의 핵·미사일 프로그램 등이 국가 안보, 외교 정책, 경제에 여전히 비상하고 심각한 위협으로 작용하고 있다며 북한에 대한 ‘국가비상사태(national emergency)’를 1년 연장한다고 밝혔다. 이날 연방 관보에 게재된 통보문을 보면 트럼프는 “한반도에서의 무기급 핵분열 물질 확산 위험, 북한 정부의 행동·정책이 계속 비상하고 심각한 위협을 제기하고 있다”며 대북 제재의 근거가 되는 국가비상사태가 26일 이후로도 계속 유지된다고 통보했다.)

The national emergency concerning North Korea was first declared in June 2008 by President George W. Bush via Executive Order 13466. It designated the nuclear crisis on the Korean Peninsula as a national emergency, leading the U.S. government to implement various economic sanctions, including asset freezes. Through major events such as the 2010 sinking of the Cheonan, nuclear tests, and the 2011 UN Security Council resolutions, successive presidents have expanded its scope through additional executive orders. Grounds for maintaining the state of emergency were added over cyberattacks and human rights abuses by North Korea (2015), its pursuit of nuclear and missile programs (2016), and intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) launches and nuclear tests (2017). (대북 국가비상사태는 2008년 6월 조지 W. 부시 대통령이 행정명령 13466호를 통해 처음 선포했다. 한반도 핵 위기를 국가 긴급 상황의 대상으로 규정했고 이후 미 정부가 자산 동결 같은 각종 경제 제재 조치를 시행해 왔다. 2010년 천안함 폭침과 핵실험, 2011년 유엔 안보리 결의 등 주요 사건을 거치면서 역대 대통령들이 추가 행정명령을 통해 그 범위를 지속적으로 확대했다. 북한의 사이버 공격·인권 침해(2015년), 핵·미사일 프로그램 추구(2016년), 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM) 발사와 핵실험(2017년) 등이 비상사태를 유지하는 근거로 추가됐다.)

To extend the effectiveness of the national emergency concerning North Korea, a process of notifying Congress and publishing in the Federal Register by the end of June each year is required under the sunset provisions of the National Emergencies Act. The U.S. has renewed this annually since 2008, with Trump sending a letter to Congress on June 22 and the notice being published in the Federal Register on June 24. Although Trump, upon his return to power, has referred to Kim Jong Un as a "nuclear power" and repeatedly expressed a willingness to engage in dialogue, the White House and State Department have maintained the official stance of "pursuing the complete denuclearization of North Korea." Recently, some voices in U.S. political circles have argued that complete denuclearization has become elusive and that the U.S. should first pursue an interim agreement with North Korea. (대북 국가비상사태는 효력을 연장하려면 근거 법률인 국가비상법의 일몰 규정에 따라 매년 6월 말 의회에 통보하고 관보에 게재하는 절차를 밟아야 한다. 미국은 2008년 이후 해마다 이를 갱신해 오고 있는데, 트럼프는 22일 의회에 서한을 보내 24일 관보를 통해 통보문이 공개된 것이다. 트럼프가 재집권한 이후 김정은을 ‘핵 보유 세력’이라 부르며 대화 의지를 거듭해서 밝히고 있지만, 백악관과 국무부 등은 “북한의 완전한 비핵화를 추구한다”라는 공식 입장을 계속해서 유지하고 있다. 최근 미 조야(朝野)에선 완전한 비핵화는 요원해졌고 북한과 중간 단계 합의부터 추구해야 한다는 주장이 일각에서 나오고 있다.)

item.title: Han Byeong-do: "We Must Meet as One Team at the End of the Convention Race… Full Preparation" (한병도 “전대 경쟁 끝에서 원팀으로 만나야…준비 만전”)
item.description:
Han Byeong-do: "We Must Meet as One Team at the End of the Convention Race… Full Preparation" (한병도 “전대 경쟁 끝에서 원팀으로 만나야…준비 만전” )

Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 25th, "This national convention to elect new leadership should be a festival for the people where the dignity of competition and the value of harmony coexist." (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 “새로운 지도부를 선출하는 이번 전당대회는 경쟁의 품격과 화합의 가치가 공존하는 국민의 축제가 되어야 한다”고 25일 말했다.)

Acting leader Han made these remarks during the party's floor strategy meeting, stating, "The reason we compete is not to defeat one another, but to become a stronger united whole." (한 대행은 이날 당 원내대책회의에서 “우리가 경쟁하는 이유는 서로를 쓰러뜨리기 위해서가 아니라 더 단단한 하나가 되기 위한 것”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Han said, "The strongest moments of the Democratic Party have always been when we were scattered and then joined hands again," adding, "Even if we fiercely contend, we must respect the public sentiment toward the people and party members. At the end of the competition, we must surely meet as one team." (한 대행은 “민주당이 가장 강했던 순간은 언제나 흩어져 있다가 다시 손을 맞잡았을 때”라면서 “치열하게 다투더라도 국민과 당원을 향한 민심만큼은 서로 존중해야 한다. 경쟁의 끝에서 우리는 반드시 원팀으로 만나야 한다”고 했다.)

Han stated, "This national convention is not a fight over who wins, but a place to prove that the Democratic Party is a responsible ruling party before the people," and added, "As acting party leader, I will ensure there is not a single gap in preparation and will be fully ready." (한 대행은 “이번 전당대회는 누가 이기냐의 싸움이 아니라, 민주당이 국민 앞에 책임 있는 집권당임을 증명하는 자리”라면서 “당대표 직무대행으로서 준비의 한 치의 빈틈이 없이 만전을 기하겠다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the formation of the second half of the National Assembly, Han emphasized, "We must open a plenary session within this week and complete the election of standing committee chairs." Han said, "We can no longer neglect the paralysis of the National Assembly," and added, "I strongly request the National Assembly Speaker to exercise authority under the National Assembly Act. Please immediately assign the 18 standing committees according to the National Assembly Act." (한편 한 대행은 국회 하반기 원 구성과 관련해 “이번 주 안으로 본회의를 열어 상임위원장 선출까지 마쳐야 한다”고 강조했다. 한 대행은 “국회 마비 상태를 더 이상 방치할 수 없다”면서 “국회법에 따른 국회의장의 권한 행사를 강력히 요청드린다. 의장께서 국회법에 따라 18개 상임위원회를 즉시 배정해달라”고 했다.)

At a press conference the previous day, Han also stated, "If the People Power Party does not submit the list of standing committee members by the 26th, the Democratic Party will take responsibility and operate all 18 standing committees." (한 대행은 전날 기자회견에서도 “국민의힘이 26일까지 상임위 명단을 제출하지 않으면 민주당이 18개 상임위를 책임지고 운영하겠다”고 했었다.)

item.title: North Korea Repeats Claim that "6.25 War Was North's Invasion"...Emphasizes "Arming with Anti-U.S. Struggle Consciousness" (北 “6·25는 북침“ 주장 되풀이...”반미 투쟁의식 무장해야")
item.description:
North Korea Repeats Claim that "6.25 War Was North's Invasion"...Emphasizes "Arming with Anti-U.S. Struggle Consciousness" (北 “6·25는 북침“ 주장 되풀이...”반미 투쟁의식 무장해야")

On the 76th anniversary of the outbreak of the Korean War (June 25), North Korea churned out concentrated propaganda reports highlighting its will to resist the United States and South Korea, stressing the ideological arming of its citizens. (북한은 6·25 전쟁 발발 76주년 기념일인 25일 대미·대남 항전 의지를 부각하는 선동 보도를 집중적으로 쏟아내며 주민의 사상 무장을 강조했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun, the official newspaper of the Workers' Party, published an editorial on its front page titled "Let All People Become Strongly Armed Defenders of the Revolution and Class Vanguard Fighters with Anti-Imperialist Class Consciousness." (노동당 기관지 노동신문은 이날 ‘전체 인민이 반제계급의식으로 튼튼히 무장한 혁명의 수호자, 계급의 전위투사가 되자’라는 제목의 사설을 1면에 게재했다.)

The editorial called for residents to be thoroughly armed with an anti-U.S. struggle consciousness, stating, "Let us firmly prepare as defenders of the revolution and class vanguard fighters filled with surging hatred and determination to annihilate the U.S. imperialists and class enemies, achieve decisive victory in the anti-imperialist, anti-U.S. showdown, and endlessly glorify our style of socialism." It further urged constant ideological arming, saying, "If we treat enemies approaching with fake smiles carelessly and harbor even the slightest illusion, our view of the main enemy will become blurred, and tragic years could repeat." It added, "No matter how the situation changes, the people and the People's Army soldiers must not have even a speck of illusion or lingering attachment to the enemy or peace." <<> On the same day, an essay on page six reiterated the existing claim that the Korean War was a northern invasion orchestrated by the United States under a meticulous script. The Rodong Sinmun asserted, "At dawn on June 25, 1950, the South Korean puppet army launched an armed invasion against our Republic," pushing the narrative of a North Korean invasion. It also said, "Due to the U.S. imperialists' war provocation, our people and army had no choice but to wage a stern 1,129-day Fatherland Liberation War to repel the imperialist armed invasion and protect their fate and future." <<> Regarding the UN forces' participation following the UN Security Council resolution after the war's outbreak, it denied its legitimacy, stating, "This was entirely according to the U.S. script and is completely illegal." <<> "Vengeance resolution meetings" were held across North Korea to stoke residents' animosity toward the United States and South Korea. The Korean Central News Agency reported that at a vengeance resolution meeting held on June 24 at the education ground of the Central Class Education Hall in Pyongyang, Women's Union officials and members "sternly condemned the heinous crimes of U.S. imperialists in the name of all mothers and women in the country." At another vengeance resolution meeting for young students held at the Pyongyang Youth Park Open-Air Theater, participants spoke, saying, "The 6.25 War began as a northern invasion by the U.S.," and "Every time we face June 25, which brought unprecedented calamity to our homeland, our surging hatred for the sworn enemy, the U.S. imperialists, boils over even more." <<> North Korea designates the Korean War as the "Fatherland Liberation War" and commemorates June 25 each year as a day of struggle against the U.S. imperialists, emphasizing ideological education for its citizens. (사설은 “미제와 계급적 원쑤들에 대한 치솟는 증오심과 멸적의 의지를 만장약한(가득 채운) 혁명의 수호자, 계급의 전위투사로 억세게 준비하여 반제반미대결전에서 결정적승리를 이룩하고 우리식 사회주의를 끝없이 빛내어 나가자”면서 주민들의 투철한 반미 투쟁의식 무장을 요구했다. 이어 “거짓웃음을 지으며 다가드는 적들을 무경각하게 대하면서 사소한 환상이라도 가진다면 주적관이 흐려지게 되고 비극적인 년대가 되풀이될수 있다”며 “인민들과 인민군장병들은 정세가 어떻게 변하든 적과 평화에 대한 티끌만한 환상과 미련도 가지지 말아야 한다”며 상시적인 사상 무장을 주문했다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok Head to Jeonbuk Together...Courting Honam Party Sentiment (정청래·김민석 나란히 전북행...호남 당심에 구애)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok Head to Jeonbuk Together...Courting Honam Party Sentiment (정청래·김민석 나란히 전북행...호남 당심에 구애)

Jeong Cheong-rae, a former party leader, and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, both likely candidates for the next party leadership election of the Democratic Party of Korea, will visit Jeonbuk on the 25th. (더불어민주당 차기 당대표 선거 출마가 유력한 정청래 전 대표와 김민석 국무총리가 25일 나란히 전북을 찾는다.)

According to political sources, the two will attend a workshop for winners of the June 3 local elections hosted by the Jeonbuk Provincial Party, set to be held at a training institute in Jeongeup, North Jeolla Province, for a one-night, two-day schedule starting that day. Former leader Jeong, who resigned from his party leadership role the previous day, effectively formalizing his bid for re-election, chose to head to Honam immediately. Prime Minister Kim also returned late the previous night from a two-night, three-day trip to China for the Summer Davos Forum and is now heading straight to Jeonbuk upon arrival. (정치권에 따르면, 정 전 대표와 김 총리는 이날부터 전북 정읍의 한 연수원에서 1박 2일 일정으로 열리는 전북도당 6·3 지방선거 당선자 워크숍에 참석한다. 전날 당대표직을 사퇴하며 사실상 연임 도전을 공식화한 정 전 대표가 다음 날 바로 호남행을 택한 것이다. 김 총리 역시 하계 다보스 포럼 참석 일정으로 2박 3일 일정으로 중국을 방문했다가 전날 늦게 귀국했는데, 귀국 직후 전북을 향하는 것이 된다.)

The two key contenders for party power have been increasingly focusing on Honam, the Democratic Party's largest stronghold. Former leader Jeong has visited Honam six times since the June 3 local elections to meet with party members, while Prime Minister Kim toured Honam from the 16th to the 19th. Honam, where a third of the Democratic Party's eligible voting members are concentrated, is considered the decisive battleground for the upcoming party leadership election. (유력 당권 주자인 두 사람은 최근 앞다퉈 민주당 최대 텃밭인 호남에 공을 들이고 있다. 정 전 대표는 6·3 지방선거 이후에만 여섯 차례 호남을 찾아 당원들을 만났고, 김 총리도 지난 16~19일 호남을 돌았다. 호남은 민주당 권리당원 3분의 1이 포진해 이번 당대표 선거 최대 승부처로 꼽힌다.)
